# Lab 24.3: Materialized View Recommendations

## What We Are Going to Do
Run the same aggregation many times, read the materialized view recommendation, create the view and check query rewrite.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a repeated aggregation pattern.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --nouse_cache \
  'SELECT DATE(trip_start_timestamp) AS day, company, COUNT(*) AS trips, SUM(fare) AS fares
   FROM lab24.trips GROUP BY day, company' &gt; /dev/null
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Read the recommendation.** After it appears (up to a day), open the **Materialized view** recommendation. It shows the suggested SQL and the estimated slot-hours saved.

3. **[SQL] Create the materialized view.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW lab24.mv_daily_company AS
SELECT DATE(trip_start_timestamp) AS day, company, COUNT(*) AS trips, SUM(fare) AS fares
FROM lab24.trips
GROUP BY day, company;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Check rewrite.** Run the original query from step 1. **Execution details** shows it reading `mv_daily_company`.

5. **[Console] Mark it as applied.** Open the recommendation and click **Mark as applied**.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Trigger | Same aggregation run often |
| Recommendation | Suggested MV SQL |
| Result | Base-table queries rewritten |
| State | `SUCCEEDED` after marking applied |
